purpose: Calibrate this repository's Audio2Tool direct baseline against arXiv:2604.22821 Table 3 by varying the two protocol facts that have never been varied: Factor A, the output contract (13k-token raw registry text demanding a bare JSON array, versus an OpenAI-format native tools list the pinned GGUF chat template renders itself), and Factor D, the audio path (raw audio through the bf16 mmproj versus mmproj-free speech-feature packets). A0's 34 pp Tier-1 tool-accuracy miss against the paper row stopped the 2026-08-07 reproduction plan's P1 gate; the 2026-09-03 zero-contact scorer study showed scorer semantics explain part of the exact-match gap and none of the tool-selection gap (142 of 303 A0 exact-match failures are wrong tool sets, 20 of 50 on Tier 1), so the remaining gap sits in the request protocol. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-03-a2t-direct-baseline-calibration-v1-preregistration.md.

population.strata: 50 samples per tier across all eight Audio2Tool tiers
population.selection: the frozen 400 split, no draw; already exposed by A0 (row SAEA-BASE-a2t-a0-400)
population.estimand: equal-tier reporting, with the natural construction mixture reported beside it as a reweighting

shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor for every cell
shared_protocol.a0_not_reused_as_a_cell: A0's build (5d9dfcb58) and D2 arm (fixed-legal-context) both differ; it stays the historical anchor, not a cell

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 1,600 = 4 cells x 400 items, plus 8 canaries; registered ceiling 1,700
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 4 x 2,159.688 s = 8,638.752 s, rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires; registered ceiling 9,000
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 6.0; A0's resumed attempt ran 85 raw-audio calls in 1,895 s at -np 4, and the packet cells are faster
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values

evaluation.factor_b_costs_zero_contacts: every cell is scored with both a2t-toolcall (v1) and a2t-toolcall-v2 through core.scoring_batch, one job per complete manifest
mandatory_slices: all eight tiers, with the paper row beside every tier
main effect A (native minus legacy) within each audio path

decision.acceptance: Acceptance of the calibration: at least one cell reaches per-tier tool-accuracy |delta| <= 5 pp against the paper row on Tiers 1, 2, 5 and 6 (the tiers the paper reports above 80 %) with the tier rank order preserved. That cell becomes the direct baseline for every later mechanism experiment and fills the umbrella published-baselines.md row.
decision.if_no_cell_passes: If no cell passes: the miss is itself the finding; report which factor moved tool accuracy and by how much, and stop mechanism work until the owner decides (Factor C, prompt-template variants, or a protocol clarification request to the paper's authors).
decision.claim_surface: Nothing here is a superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim; the population is exposed discovery data; no knob is tuned on it.
decision.not_authorized: No test contact, no mechanism arm, no Q8_0 flight, no fresh roster, no training-free policy fit, no edit to the locked SLURP cell.
